sampling_bounds: Integer exponential base 2..12; observed fixed coefficients, polynomial exponents, signs, and field layouts. Only mapped base/log pairs and specifically documented incorrect e-exponents vary.

exceptions.reason: No hard practice source exists in the complete scoped read. The six validated profiles cover sums of two exponentials (easy) and an added power, constant, or reciprocal term (moderate). Changing the base cannot substantiate a hard label. This package declines new substitution, products, or nonlinear exponents which would require new template and difficulty evidence. This is a bounded package limit, not mathematical impossibility; new source evidence reopens classification.
